text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- An anonymous pamphlet was apparently distributed at a recent Southern African Development Community (SADC) consultative conference which opposed the nomination of SADC executive secretary Kaire Mbuende for another term, on the grounds of incompetence.
- Cash-strapped Air Namibia is looking for partners to help serve its international clientele.

- Namibia will in futute be able to supply the local market with liquid oxygen and nitrogen and will also export these to neighbouring Angola, Zambia and Botswana. The Afrox company said on Tuesday it planned to invest N$4 million in a gas production plant in Windhoek towards the end of this year.
